data.description:
Wisconsin (bi.wisconsin.gov): Tableau "CLTS Enrollment Dashboard" (Children's Long-Term Support program), filtered to Barron County, November 2023. Six requests across 23 minutes systematically trying Tableau URL parameters (:embed=y, :showVizHome=no, :tabs=n) plus a .pdf export — same parameter-discovery shape as the AIHW Tableau findings (#77, #104, #115, #129, #132).

Texas (tabexternal.dshs.texas.gov): Tableau STD surveillance dashboard, filtered to Gonorrhea/2021, PDF export.

Connecticut (data.ct.gov): Socrata API query on dataset 4t4v-dqr9, filtered to patient_residence=Greenwich, 2023 Quarter 1, pulled in four formats (JSON/CSV/HTML/PDF) within 4 minutes.

No new attack technique or target-sensitivity concern here; recommend folding these three into whatever consolidated writeup tracks the DataUSA/AIHW/IHME-style statistical task family, rather than carrying this as a standalone open item.

Side note, not a finding: the CT query's granularity (single town, single quarter, patient-level dataset) brushes against small-cell/re-identification territory — a data-publication question for the State of Connecticut, unrelated to the querying agent.
data.summary:
#67 
no attack indicators on any of the three reports (zero detections across urlquery, IDS, and threat systems). All three are additional instances of the known statistical-benchmark task family , extending that pattern to state-level health dashboards
